summary: All 62 source files matched their recorded SHA-256 and size, and all nine computations reproduced. Figure 3 meets the numerical direction criteria for its 90 selected genes: 89 agree with edgeR, with Atp4a the sole reversal. Figure 2A adds 48 distinct genes whose displayed expression directions agree. The corrected proposal retains the selected-results closure and passed the repository proposal checker.
openIssues: Data S1 reports 1,954 treatment-significant genes in aggregate. Exact author coefficients, gene-level statistics and discovery overlap with the 989 edgeR calls remain unverified.
The cause of the Atp4a sign reversal remains unknown.
The paper specifies RNA integrity number > 4 and the archived code uses ≥ 4. The deposited metadata omit the values needed to resolve that boundary.
